name: What error IS under readout-not-truth: retained update, not distance to an unobserved true pose

statement.latest: \Delta_k:=\delta_R(\hat T_k,\hat T_{k-1})\quad(\text{a directly observed retained difference between consecutive readouts})\quad\text{replaces}\quad e_k:=\operatorname{Log}(\hat T_k^{-1}T^\star)\quad(\text{a distance to an unobserved }T^\star,\text{ a non-readout})
statement.note_ascii: the classical pose-error definition e_k = Log(That_k^-1 T*) requires the unobserved true pose T* -- a non-readout in this workspace's own information-discrete-math discipline (I1-style injection: treating an unread quantity as if it were a number). The readout-native replacement is the retained difference between actual consecutive readouts, Delta_k, which needs no T* at all, not even offline for calibration.

parents.evidence: this is a direct application of the workspace's own root primitive (a retained difference exists) to the specific case of consecutive pose-refinement readouts, replacing a T*-relative definition that the primitive's own discipline forbids treating as a readout.

honest_caveats: This does not claim the classical e_k is 'wrong' in the sense of being mathematically ill-defined -- T* is a coherent mathematical object under a classical-realist stance. It claims that USING it (even only offline, only for calibration) silently imports a non-readout into what this workspace's own standing discipline (EPIS-UNIVERSAL-LENS) requires flagging, and that a genuinely native alternative should be tried before concluding the whole calibration line is exhausted.

A first empirical test of this native construction would still reasonably compare its ACT/HOLD decisions against T*-derived ground truth in the lab (as an external check, not as a calibration input) -- this is a legitimate use of T* as a checker, not as a definitional ingredient, and does not violate the readout-not-truth stance any more than any other falsifiable prediction does.

name: Retained-sensitivity task admissibility: ACT licensed when the task verdict is invariant along data-justified uncertain directions, using the correspondence Hessian's own spectrum (no ground truth anywhere)

statement.latest: \text{Let }H_k\text{ be the real ICP normal-equations Hessian at stage }k\text{, with eigenpairs }(\lambda_j,v_j).\quad\text{A direction }v_j\text{ is data-justified-uncertain if }\lambda_j\text{ is small (near the proven floor);}\quad\text{the data-justified perturbation magnitude along }v_j\text{ is }\propto 1/\lambda_j\ (\text{bounded by weld/M.40.v1's ceiling and, once proven, a floor}).\quad\boxed{\text{ACT}\iff O_T(\hat T_k)=O_T(\hat T_k\oplus\epsilon v_j)\ \text{for every data-justified-uncertain }v_j}
statement.note_ascii: instead of building a calibrated completion set around an assumed true pose (needs T*), perturb the CURRENT estimate along the correspondence Hessian's own low-eigenvalue directions (the directions the DATA ITSELF says are weakly constrained -- directly computable, no ground truth needed) by a magnitude the data itself justifies (inverse eigenvalue, bounded by the proven L_R ceiling), and license ACT only if the task verdict does not change along any such direction. This reuses the real H_k eigen-structure task-conditioned-6d-pose-stop's fourth cycle already computes, but for its actually-valid purpose (identifying weakly-constrained directions) rather than the refuted purpose (a graph-diameter-based decay-rate extrapolation, which needed H_k to have graph structure it does not have).

parents.evidence: uses only retained/observed quantities (H_k's own real eigenstructure), never T*, consistent with the native error definition above

H_k's role here (identifying weakly-constrained directions via its spectrum) is the same structural role L_R plays generally; unlike PROP-DECAY-01 (refuted, run 4), this construction does NOT require H_k to have graph/diameter structure -- it only uses H_k's own eigenvalues directly, which always exist for any real symmetric matrix, sidestepping run 4's exact refutation.
bounds the largest data-justified perturbation direction's inverse-eigenvalue magnitude from below (a small perturbation bound on the best-constrained directions)

honest_caveats: This is a genuinely new construction, not yet implemented or tested as of registration -- Toledo-first: registered before use.

Unlike PROP-DECAY-01, this does NOT need q_formal/M.07's diameter-based floor at all (no graph diameter is needed), which removes that proposal's central structural flaw -- but it still needs its own correctness argument for WHY invariance-under-data-justified-perturbation licenses ACT with any coverage-like guarantee; this is currently a Dr-tier design, not a proven guarantee, and needs the same kind of adversarial scrutiny every prior cycle's hypothesis received before being trusted.

The relationship between 'small eigenvalue direction' and 'actual pose error along that direction' is itself an assumption (weakly-constrained by these correspondences does not automatically mean large true error) -- must be checked empirically, honestly, the same way runs 1-4 checked their own assumptions.

resistance_evidence.empirical_test_status: Run 5 executed 2026-09-09 (task-conditioned-6d-pose-stop, lab/results/real-bop-lmo-2026-09-09-run5/RESULT.md), predeclaration commit 43954c09eedda7f3802adee6d83b559c836d19e6. This is the first of five real-data cycles on this problem to license ACT at all, and it did so unsafely: ACT fired on 100% of test episodes for all three declared tasks, always at the very first ICP stage (k=0, before any refinement), and was wrong (unsafe ACT) on 92.5-100% of those episodes. This directly refutes this proposal's own honest_caveats item ('the relationship between a small eigenvalue direction and actual pose error along that direction is itself an assumption ... must be checked empirically') at least at this trajectory stage on this backend. Diagnosed cause: the perturbation magnitude this construction produces (bounded by a TRAIN-derived CAP) is systematically smaller than the real coarse-detector initial-pose error, so the invariance test answers a much easier question (is a tiny wobble around the current estimate tolerable) than the one it needs to answer (is the current estimate close to correct). H_k's spectral floor alone, without an absolute residual/noise-scale term (the kind PROP-DECAY-01's own predictor already paired with its contraction rate), is not a safe proxy for pose-estimate uncertainty on this backend. PROP-NATIVE-03 (already registered, parented to this proposal) proposes a persistence/memory-accumulator refinement as one candidate next iteration; a residual-scale-paired variant of this proposal's own perturbation magnitude is another, not yet registered.

name: Memory-accumulated decision rule: ACT licensed only on a persistent streak of task-invariance, not a single-instant check

statement.latest: M_k := M_{k-1} + \mathbb{1}[\text{task verdict invariant under every imagined perturbation at stage } k],\quad M_0:=0,\quad \boxed{\text{ACT} \iff M_k \ge \theta} \text{ (a predeclared persistence threshold)}
statement.note_ascii: M_k accumulates a streak count of consecutive stages where the single-instant imagination+reason check (PROP-NATIVE-02) found the task verdict invariant under every data-justified perturbation; ACT is licensed only once the streak reaches a predeclared threshold theta, not on a single passing instant. A telescoping accumulator in the same idiom as root A2 (FOLD engine).

parents.evidence: adds a persistence/memory requirement on top of the single-instant imagination+reason check, to filter noise-driven false invariance on real, noisy sensor data
M_k is a telescoping accumulator over a binary per-stage readout, the same generic FOLD-engine shape as root A2 (I_+[f](N) = sum_{k<N} f[k])

honest_caveats: Founder framing (verbatim, 2026-09-09): human imagination and reason connect through memory and work simultaneously to decide -- this proposal is the readout-native translation of that observation for this specific problem, not a claim about neuroscience.

A streak-based threshold theta trades responsiveness for noise-robustness; too small a theta gives little protection over the single-instant check (PROP-NATIVE-02) already being tested; too large a theta may prevent ACT from ever firing even when it honestly should, the same failure mode as runs 1-4.
Not yet implemented or tested -- proposed as the next iteration if the single-instant H3 (PROP-NATIVE-01/02, run 5) proves too noise-sensitive to certify reliably.

Empirically refuted 2026-09-09 (run6): on this backend/dataset, the underlying single-instant check (PROP-NATIVE-02) is a near-constant function of stage, so a streak/memory accumulator has nothing to filter and degenerates into a fixed-delay knob. This does not rule out memory/persistence constructions in general -- only that gating a non-noisy signal behind persistence cannot recover safety by itself.

name: Conformal-scaled, Keystone-energy, decay-accumulated task admissibility: replace the undersized TRAIN cap with the already-calibrated conformal quantile, and replace the boolean streak with a decayed real-valued energy accumulator

statement.latest: \text{Let }H_k,(\lambda_j,v_j)\text{ be as in PROP-NATIVE-02, and }q_{k}\text{ the PROP-CONF-03 per-checkpoint Bonferroni conformal quantile}\quad(\text{calibrated OFFLINE on the }n=40\text{ calibration set only, never online}).\quad\text{Perturbation magnitude: }\epsilon_{k,j}:=\min\!\big(q_{k}/\lambda_j,\ \text{weld/M.40.v1 ceiling}\big)\ \text{(replaces run 5's fixed TRAIN-derived CAP)}.\quad\text{Per-stage invariance: }\iota_k:=\mathbb{1}[O_T(\hat T_k)=O_T(\hat T_k\oplus\epsilon_{k,j}v_j)\ \forall\text{ data-justified }j].\quad\text{Per-stage Keystone energy: }\Gamma_k:=\sum_j \lambda_j\,\epsilon_{k,j}^2\quad(\text{the Dirichlet quadratic form }\Phi^TL_R\Phi\text{ specialized }L_R\!\to\!H_k,\ \Phi\to\epsilon_k,\text{ per Toledo root Keystone}).\quad\text{Decayed accumulator (A2-FOLD, real-valued carrier): }m_k:=\rho\,m_{k-1}+\iota_k\,\Gamma_k,\ m_0:=0,\ \rho\in(0,1)\text{ predeclared}.\quad\boxed{\text{ACT at first checkpoint }k_m\text{ s.t. }m_{k_m}\ge\theta\ \text{AND}\ q_{k_m}\le\tau_i\ (\text{task tolerance, C11})}
statement.note_ascii: Three changes on top of PROP-NATIVE-02/03, one per diagnosed defect: (1) the perturbation magnitude eps_{k,j} that was previously capped by a fixed TRAIN-derived constant (diagnosed by run 5 as far smaller than the real coarse-detector initial-pose error) is now capped by q_k, the PROP-CONF-03 per-checkpoint conformal quantile -- an already-Toledo-registered, CONTINUUM_AUDIT-rated LOW-RISK, genuinely calibrated absolute-scale bound, calibrated offline against T* on the n=40 calibration set only (never used online on a test episode -- consistent with PROP-NATIVE-01's own honest_caveats on T* as checker vs definitional ingredient). (2) the per-stage signal fed to the accumulator is no longer a bare boolean (run 6's degenerate, non-toggling 0/1 indicator) but Gamma_k, the real-valued Keystone quadratic-form energy of the actual perturbation under H_k -- a genuine magnitude, not a pass/fail flag. (3) the accumulator itself is a DECAYED real-valued running sum (rho<1, Chapter-39/eq.19-shaped momentum) rather than run 6's hard reset-to-zero streak counter, so a single non-invariant stage does not wipe accumulated evidence outright, and stale evidence decays rather than persisting forever. ACT requires BOTH the accumulated energy to clear a predeclared threshold theta AND the calibrated conformal envelope at that checkpoint to already fit inside the task's own declared tolerance tau_i -- tying the decision back to the project's own task-conditioned admissibility region (C11), not to eigenvalue geometry alone.

parents.evidence: keeps PROP-NATIVE-02's forced move (perturb along H_k's own data-justified-uncertain directions, license ACT iff the task verdict is invariant) but replaces its diagnosed defect -- a fixed TRAIN-derived perturbation-magnitude CAP shown by run 5 to be systematically smaller than the real coarse-detector initial-pose error -- with the calibrated conformal quantile q_k as the magnitude scale.

keeps the idea of accumulating evidence over stages (memory/persistence) but replaces its diagnosed defect -- a boolean per-stage indicator that never toggled on this backend, degenerating the streak into a fixed-delay knob, plus a hard reset-to-zero streak counter -- with a real-valued per-stage energy (Gamma_k, not a 0/1 flag) fed through a decayed (not hard-reset) accumulator, so the accumulator can carry genuine magnitude information even when the underlying per-stage check is near-constant.

reuses PROP-CONF-03's per-checkpoint Bonferroni-corrected conformal quantile q_{k_m} as the source of absolute residual-scale information that runs 4-6 (PROP-DECAY-01, PROP-NATIVE-01/02/03) each lacked -- this quantile is calibrated OFFLINE against T* on the n=40 calibration set only (a legitimate checker use of T*, per PROP-NATIVE-01's own honest_caveats), never referenced online on a test episode, so combining it with a native local check does not reintroduce a non-readout at decision time. CONTINUUM_AUDIT_20260909.md rates this marginal-coverage machinery (C16-C18) LOW RISK, already well-handled -- the one part of the project's formalization independently flagged as sound. PROP-CONF-03 itself remains unverified/not yet empirically tested as of this registration; using it here does not upgrade its own tier, and this proposal inherits that open risk (see honest_caveats).

Gamma_k := sum_j lambda_j * eps_{k,j}^2 is exactly Toledo's proven (Th_coqc, formal/IDM_Keystone.v) Dirichlet/retained-information quadratic-form identity Phi^T L_R Phi = I(Phi), specialized with L_R -> H_k and Phi -> the stage-k perturbation eps_k -- the same L_R -> H_k structural bridge PROP-NATIVE-02 already licensed (via its own L_R parent), now applied to the ENERGY value of L_R's quadratic form rather than only its spectral ceiling/floor extremes, which is the specific unused ingredient the Toledo-lens read of this registry identified (runs 4-6 used only weld/M.40.v1/weld/M.42.v1's spectral bounds and q_formal/M.07.v1's unproven floor, never Keystone's own proven energy value).

m_k is still a telescoping FOLD-shaped accumulator (I_+[f](N) = sum_{k<N} f[k]) in root A2's generic sense, but generalized from run 6's impoverished boolean carrier to a real-valued, decayed carrier (rho * m_{k-1} + iota_k * Gamma_k) -- root A2 was always registered generic over carrier/operation; run 6 only ever instantiated the boolean special case.
still bounds eps_{k,j} from above (min with the proven ceiling), unchanged from PROP-NATIVE-02's own use of this bound.

honest_caveats: Designed specifically to avoid two named, diagnosed failure modes: run 5's (PROP-NATIVE-02) undersized, TRAIN-population-borrowed perturbation magnitude (fixed here by substituting the calibrated per-checkpoint conformal quantile q_k), and run 6's (PROP-NATIVE-03) degenerate boolean/hard-streak accumulator that could not filter a non-toggling signal (fixed here by accumulating a real-valued Keystone energy through a decayed running sum instead of a 0/1 streak count).
This is a DESIGN artifact only -- Dr tier, status unverified, NOT YET IMPLEMENTED OR TESTED. No empirical claim is made here; run 7 (Execute phase) is what tests it.

Open risk 1 (over-correction): q_k may now be large enough relative to lambda_j that eps_{k,j} over-estimates tolerable perturbation, trading runs 5-6's unsafe-early-ACT failure mode for the opposite failure mode -- HOLD too long or never ACT at all. Both directions must be checked empirically; non-inferiority on ACT-rate as well as safety must be reported, not only safety.

Open risk 2 (borrowed, untested calibration layer): PROP-CONF-03's own quantile construction is itself unverified/not yet empirically run in this project (its origin explicitly states 'not yet implemented or tested'); this proposal inherits that open risk rather than resolving it -- if q_k's calibration is itself flawed (e.g. the same n=40/K'-checkpoint feasibility tension diagnosed in runs 1-3), that flaw propagates into this construction's magnitude scale.

Open risk 3 (same-split reuse, methodological gap independently flagged by the glosa-methodology lens): this design, like all six prior real-data cycles, is stated against the identical BOP-LMO TRAIN/CALIBRATION(n=40)/TEST split. It does not by itself close that gap; if the founder wants a second independent calibration split checked in the same cycle, that must be predeclared as an additional falsifier in run 7's own predeclaration, not assumed here.

Open risk 4 (bridge, not proof): the H_k -> L_R structural analogy underlying both the weld/M.40.v1 ceiling bound and the Keystone energy identity used here is the same UNPROVEN bridge PROP-NATIVE-02 already carried (H_k is a real symmetric PSD Hessian, not literally a graph Laplacian with diameter structure) -- this proposal does not newly prove that bridge, only reuses the same structural motivation PROP-NATIVE-02 already relied on for its (partially) successful half (the invariance-check framing itself was not what run 5 refuted; the magnitude was).

Open risk 5 (new free parameters): rho (decay rate) and theta (accumulation threshold) are new predeclared constants with no principled value derived here; per this project's own predeclaration discipline (rigorous-diagnosis / P08), they must be fixed from TRAIN data alone before test.jsonl is opened, and the choice must be disclosed in run 7's own predeclaration commit, exactly as prior cycles disclosed CAP/theta choices.

name: Transduce-then-resonate-then-decide: a Policy-argmin stopping rule built from readout_genesis's Active World-Readout Loop, keeping the imagination/reason/memory triad intact

statement.latex: \text{Let } r_k \text{ be the raw per-stage signal (Hessian eigenpair, residual, conformal quantile). Do NOT threshold } r_k \text{ directly (the Ω_H lesson: raw-carrier resonance is a category error).}\quad\text{Transduce: } \omega_{A,k} := C_H(E_H(T_H(S_H(r_{k-w:k})))) \text{ -- a compressed envelope/trend over a short window } w, \text{ not the instantaneous value.}\quad\text{Resonate (reason, generalized from PROP-NATIVE-02's binary invariance to a graded gain): } G_k := 1/(1+(\omega_{A,k}\tau_c-1)^2).\quad\text{Imagine: } C_k := \{z : r_k \text{ does not exclude } z\} \text{ (unchanged from PROP-NATIVE-01).}\quad\text{Remember (decayed, from Ch.39 eq.19 / readout_genesis VIII.4's repair rate, refining PROP-NATIVE-03's hard streak): } M_k := \rho M_{k-1} + G_k\cdot\Gamma_k,\ \Gamma_k:=\text{Keystone energy of the perturbation (PROP-NATIVE-04's ingredient)}.\quad\text{Decide (readout_genesis VIII.3 Step 5, POLICY): } \text{ACT} \iff \pi^*=\arg\min_{a\in\{\text{ACT},\text{CONTINUE}\}}\big[E\|\text{Res}\|^2(M_k) + \lambda C(k) + \rho\,\text{Risk}(M_k) - \nu\,\text{Val}(k) + \mu\,\text{RepairLoss}\big] = \text{ACT}.
statement.note_ascii: Synthesizes three prior threads rather than replacing them: (1) the imagination/reason/memory triad already derived from delta_R/A2/L_R (PROP-NATIVE-01/02/03, docs/DECISION_EQUATION_FROM_READOUT_METAPHYSICS.md) is kept intact -- C_k (imagination) is unchanged, the reason/discharge condition is generalized from a binary invariance check to a graded resonance gain, and the memory accumulator is kept but now weighted by both the resonance gain and a real scale-valued Keystone energy (PROP-NATIVE-04's ingredient) instead of a boolean; (2) readout_genesis's own Active World-Readout Loop (Part VIII, Th_coqc-adjacent Dr/Open tier, NOT yet a Toledo-coded canonical entry) supplies two ingredients every prior pose-stop run lacked: the Omega_H transduction discipline (never threshold a raw signal directly -- select/transduce/extract-envelope/compress it first, the exact lesson of why raw-carrier resonance predicts humans should be blind to light) diagnoses runs 4-7's shared failure mode (all thresholded H_k/residual/streak values directly, none transduced them into an envelope/trend first); and the POLICY step's 5-term argmin (epistemic residual, cost, risk, value, repair-loss) replaces every prior run's single-threshold-on-uncertainty framing with an explicit economic tradeoff, matching the founder's own instruction that reason+imagination+memory must work together and decide, not that a single number crossing a line decides.

the binary invariance/reason check is generalized to a graded resonance gain G_k, addressing run 5's diagnosed failure (an all-or-nothing check on an undersized perturbation) with a continuous alternative.

honest_caveats: readout_genesis's Active World-Readout Loop (Part VIII: SENSE/RECORD/PHENOMENALIZE/RESONANCE/POLICY/ACT+REPAIR, and the Omega_H Horizon Transduction Operator) is ITSELF tiered Dr/Open in its home repository, not Th_coqc -- it is an internally-consistent, falsifiable theoretical model of human perception/policy, not a proven law. Parenting this pose-stop proposal to it means PROP-NATIVE-05 inherits that same Dr/Open status; it does not become more proven by analogy to a human-cognition model that is itself unproven.

The transduction stage (S_H/T_H/E_H/C_H, here collapsed to a single windowed-envelope extraction over the last w stages) is the least specified part of this proposal -- readout_genesis's own text states this pipeline has NOT been checked as a formal commuting-square even in its home domain (vision/audition), let alone adapted here. Choosing window width w, and exactly what 'envelope extraction' means for a 6D pose residual sequence, is genuine new design work, not a lookup.

The POLICY argmin's four extra terms (cost, risk, value, repair-loss) require real, disclosed, TRAIN-only-derived numbers for this specific robotic task (time cost per ICP iteration, a calibrated risk estimate from runs 5-7's own unsafe-ACT rates, a stated task value, and an estimated repair/re-attempt cost) -- these are economic parameters this project has never had to declare before (every prior run only tuned a single uncertainty threshold), and picking them honestly from TRAIN data alone, disclosed before FINAL TEST, is itself a new predeclaration discipline this run must get right.

This is explicitly a synthesis/design proposal, not yet implemented or tested -- run 8 is the first real-data test of it. Given runs 4-7's track record (four consecutive falsifications, alternating between unsafe-too-early and safe-but-never-acts), the appropriately calibrated prior is that this too may fail, and it should be tested with the same rigor and honesty as every prior cycle, not treated as the design that finally must work because it is more sophisticated.
